title: MVProductionUserRequirements
description: Post-intake user requirements for mv-production workflow. mv_type is always 'concept'. Visual style is always non-realistic (anime/cartoon). Generated by init_project.py from the intake document.

mv_type.description: Fixed to concept. For lyrics with clear imagery → lyric_imagery keyframes; for lyrics without → character_singing keyframes using reference images.

visual_style.description: Non-realistic style type: 'anime' / 'cartoon' / user-specified. All keyframe prompts use this as style anchor.

reference_images.description: Paths to user-provided artist/singer reference images. Used for character_singing keyframes.

resolution.description: Output image/video resolution. Default from available API capability (1280x720).

keyframe_style_prefix.description: Derived from visual_style. Prepended to every keyframe image prompt.

song_background.description: Background knowledge about the song: movie context, artist info, thematic intent.
